'''Power Droid Incorporated''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer that produced [[Power droid/Legends|power droids]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They had advertisements across [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
